notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Scout does not have summoning sickness.
You have a land card in hand.
description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.
